jobs.title: Senior Creative
jobs.description:
Most creatives get handed a product and a deadline. Here, you get handed a lab pass.

We are looking for a Senior Creative to join the Dyson Creative Studio in London: an in-house department built to approach creativity in a way that does justice to our iconic products.

You’ll have the chance to sit next to the engineers and scientists inventing the technology, and the designers working on colours, materials and finishes. You will find the detail nobody else noticed and turn it into work the world remembers.

About The Studio

The Dyson Creative Studio is based at Pear Tree Court in Clerkenwell, London, and led by Pablo González de la Peña, Global Head of Creative. It works alongside Dyson's product creative teams in Malmesbury, home of our UK headquarters, and at our global headquarters in Singapore.

We are a creative resource for the whole company, not just marketing. Our work can influence product creation, portfolio strategy and the way Dyson explains its technology to the world. We start at the very beginning, in the lab, so creativity is baked in from day one rather than added at the end.

In its first year, the studio has brought to life Dyson CameraJet, our biggest launch of the last decade, alongside Dyson HushJet MiniCool and Dyson Supersonic Travel. And with the pipeline of new technology coming, there is a lot more to do.

About The Role

As a Senior Creative, you will lead ideas from the first spark in the lab to launch campaigns seen around the world. Your job is to make the invisible visible: to take complex science and turn it into ideas people understand, feel and remember.

You will join the UK creative team, reporting to the Head of Creative, and work every day with creative strategists, designers, producers and the engineers behind the products. Forget the endless layers of approval that slow work down and kill good ideas by a thousand cuts. Here, you will present your ideas directly to Dyson's leadership, including James and Jake Dyson.

What you'll do

Connect with engineering and research teams early in development, investigating everything they do to find the detail that could become a compelling story
Create big, ownable ideas for global product launches and brand campaigns, across film, social, OOH, retail, digital and whatever channel the idea needs
Apply creative thinking and lateral problem solving to real business challenges beyond marketing, from product naming and portfolio strategy to how we explain new technology
Present and sell work with confidence to senior stakeholders and Dyson's leadership
Partner with production to craft work to the highest standard, staying close to the details from idea to delivery
Collaborate with teams in Malmesbury and Singapore to bring ideas to life in markets around the world
Raise the creative bar of the studio and help shape its culture as it grows

About You

An outstanding creative thinker (copywriter or art director) with a portfolio of work that made people stop, think and talk
Senior experience at a leading creative agency or in house team, with a record of launching ideas at global scale
Endlessly curious about how things work. You would rather spend an afternoon in a lab than in a meeting room
Brilliant at simplifying the complex without dumbing it down
Comfortable working across disciplines and media, from a hero film to a single line of product copy
A natural collaborator who can hold a room, take a challenge and build on other people's ideas
Restless, ambitious, positive, resilient and allergic to the obvious answer

Awards are welcome but not required. We care most about ideas, craft and the thinking behind them.

The team you'll join

You will work alongside talent from some of the most respected agencies and brands in the world, including BBH, Wieden+Kennedy, adam&eve, BBC Creative, Accenture Song, Canva, Logitech, Converse and Beats by Dre.

Benefits

At Dyson, Reward goes beyond just salary and bonuses. Through a comprehensive package of Financial, Lifestyle, and Health Benefits, we provide support tailored to every stage of life and the moments that matter most.

Working policy

At Dyson, our vibrant campus culture is built on in-person collaboration, creativity, and shared learning. Working side by side not only fuels our innovation, but also creates a strong sense of belonging. To nurture this dynamic and inclusive environment, we do not offer a regular hybrid working arrangement.

Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don’t think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our technology so unique. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other any other dimension of diversity.

We're hiring: Creative Director | Dubai | Full-time

TACTECH New Media
is a Dubai-based creative technology studio working where storytelling, design and technology meet. We create immersive and interactive experiences, digital installations, films, animation/CGI, brand campaigns and content for opening ceremonies and shows.

We're looking for a Creative Director to lead our creative vision from first insight to final execution.

THE ROLE

Lead TACTECH's creative direction across immersive and interactive experiences, digital installations, films, animation/CGI, opening ceremonies, shows and campaigns. Bring the strategic thinking and conceptual discipline of an experienced agency creative leader to every brief, whether or not it is a campaign. Guide ideas from insight and concept through narrative, audience experience, visual development and final execution, in close collaboration with production and technology teams.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Creative strategy and concept leadership

Interpret client and agency briefs, uncover audience and business objectives, and establish a clear strategic creative rationale.
Develop original concepts, storylines, scripts, experience narratives, visitor journeys, creative treatments and presentations for corporate and entertainment projects.
Bring proven campaign thinking - audience insight, big ideas, messaging and consistency across touchpoints - to campaign assignments and apply that same strategic rigor to TACTECH's wider creative work.
Shape UX scripts, user flows and screen-by-screen interactions with designers and developers; define participation or game mechanics only when they add value to a relevant experience.

Art direction and content direction

Direct key visuals, styleframes, storyboards, moodboards, design systems, animation language and presentation materials across content, campaigns and experiences.
Guide creative storytelling and execution for corporate films, opening films, footage-led content, CGI, motion graphics, AI-assisted visuals and relevant live-action productions.
Shape how stories unfold across immersive and large-format screens, opening ceremonies, show sequences and interactive applications, choosing techniques for their creative value.
Protect brand accuracy, typography, visual hierarchy, narrative clarity and consistent creative quality from early concepts through final output.

Creative team leadership and integration

Brief, mentor and review the Art Director, designers, motion artists, and external creative specialists, providing clear and actionable feedback.
Work with the Production Manager to define creative disciplines, resource needs, quality benchmarks and review checkpoints; collaborate with Producers, Technology and Technical Leads to test feasibility early.
Continuously review freelance artists' portfolios, assess creative capabilities and recommend the right specialists for each assignment in coordination with production.
Use AI creative tools proficiently to visualize and communicate ideas through concepts, visual references, styleframes, storyboards and previsualization, while maintaining high creative standards.

WHAT YOU BRING

10+ years of creative experience, including a strong agency background with hands-on campaign concept development and senior creative leadership across experiential, digital, motion/CGI or content work.
A portfolio demonstrating personal ownership of strategy, concepts and finished work across corporate and entertainment assignments, including campaign work as well as content or experiences.
Strong strategic and conceptual judgment, storytelling and script/treatment skills, and the ability to turn complex briefs into distinctive ideas and audience experiences.
Working knowledge of interactive UX and occasional gamified experiences, animation, CGI, screen content and practical physical-digital production constraints.
Confident creative presentation, multidisciplinary team leadership and a collaborative approach to resource and technical feasibility planning.
Hands-on proficiency with contemporary AI-assisted creative tools, with strong judgment about quality, originality and practical application.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Creative ideas demonstrate audience understanding, strategic relevance and originality, whatever the format or channel.
Stories, art direction, UX intent and relevant interaction mechanics translate coherently from creative pitch through implementation.
Internal and external creative teams receive clear briefs, useful reviews and timely decisions; specialists are well matched to projects.
The work demonstrates strong craft and feasibility, strengthens client confidence and elevates the studio portfolio.

ROLE BOUNDARIES AND COLLABORATION

Reporting line:
Managing Director
This is not a film-only director, conventional advertising art director, event-design/fabrication or game-studio position. TACTECH creates strategy-informed concepts, content and technology-led experiences; event operations and physical fabrication, when needed, are handled with specialist partners.

HOW TO APPLY

Submit a CV and a curated portfolio of 4-6 projects showing creative strategy or rationale, your personal concept contribution, the disciplines involved and the finished outcome. Include campaign work and relevant examples across content, immersive/interactive, corporate or entertainment projects.
Apply through the job post or send a direct email to : careers@tactech.digital

Al Barça som MÉS QUE UN CLUB
perquè tenim un ferm propòsit: volem transformar el món a través de la nostra manera d’entendre l’esport, amb la nostra essència Barça, i amb el nostre compromís social.

Quina és la nostra essència?

Tenim un estil propi... quan juguem volem guanyar, però sobretot volem jugar sense renunciar al nostre estil.
Creiem en les diferents disciplines, per això competim amb 5 esports professionals diferents.
Som un Club format per més de 144.000 socis i sòcies que prenen grans decisions democràticament.
Treballem per garantir la igualtat d’oportunitats, lliures de prejudicis i la no discriminació per raons d'origen, gènere, discapacitat o edat, i fomentem la inclusió de la diversitat de manera equitativa entre totes les persones del nostre entorn.

Què busquem?

L’Àrea de Barça Identity busca incorporar una persona per a la posició de Creative Producer Manager
, amb la missió de liderar la producció integral de campanyes, continguts i projectes especials, assegurant l’excel·lència en l’execució, l’eficiència operativa i la màxima qualitat creativa.
Aquesta persona serà una figura clau per convertir les idees en produccions d’alt impacte, connectant els equips interns amb una sòlida xarxa de partners, talent i proveïdors externs. Busquem un perfil capaç de combinar visió estratègica, criteri creatiu i una gran capacitat d’execució, garantint que cada projecte es desenvolupi amb els estàndards de qualitat, eficiència i innovació que defineixen la marca Barça.

Responsabilitats principals:

Liderar projectes de producció de principi a fi: planificació, pressupost, producció, execució i tancament.
Definir l’estratègia de producció més adequada en funció dels objectius creatius, els terminis i els recursos disponibles.
Gestionar, consolidar i ampliar una xarxa de proveïdors, talent i col·laboradors locals i internacionals.
Negociar pressupostos i assegurar el millor equilibri entre qualitat, cost i terminis d’execució.
Aportar criteri creatiu i sensibilitat visual al llarg de tot el procés de producció.
Supervisar les fases de producció i postproducció, vetllant pel compliment dels estàndards de qualitat.
Coordinar equips interns i partners externs, alineant les necessitats creatives, de negoci i de producció.
Gestionar els pressupostos amb rigor i garantir el compliment dels terminis, processos i objectius establerts.

Perfil Professional:

Entre 8 i 12 anys d’experiència en producció creativa, branded content, publicitat o continguts.
Experiència en productores, agències creatives o equips in-house d’alt nivell.
Coneixement profund de l’ecosistema creatiu de Barcelona i una xarxa consolidada de contactes i proveïdors.
Excel·lents capacitats d’organització, negociació i gestió simultània de múltiples projectes.
Sòlid criteri visual i una alta sensibilitat per la qualitat creativa i l’excel·lència en l’execució.
Capacitat per prendre decisions, treballar en entorns exigents i liderar projectes amb autonomia.
Perfil amb visió estratègica i orientació a l’execució, amb una clara mentalitat hands-on.

Experiència en el desenvolupament de campanyes internacionals.
Coneixement del sector de l’entreteniment, els continguts digitals i els formats OOH.
Experiència tant en produccions àgils per a entorns socials i estratègies always-on, mantenint els màxims estàndards de qualitat, com en la gestió de produccions de gran format i alta complexitat.

jobs.description:
Description

Amazon’s Brand Innovation Lab is looking for a talented, passionate, and a hands-on Creative (Art Director) to conceptualise and create one-of-a-kind campaigns for a wide range of brands across MENA. You’ll partner with Sales leads, Solutions Managers, Producers, and Design Technology and Engineering teams to create first-class customer experiences both online and offline by innovating with the Amazon canvas (Prime Video, Alexa, Twitch, etc.). You’ll lead projects and own client relationships, focusing on creating work that benefits the end customer while pushing the creative envelope from brief to execution, with a focus on our partnerships and sponsorships offering.

From ideation through launch, you will be responsible for delivering ambitious, insightful, and data-driven concepts that translate needs and constraints into customer-focused brand campaign ideas and solutions. You will be equally strong at concept and execution and an expert in leveraging AI tools and workflows, articulating end-to-end creative solutions, and turning that vision into high-quality experiences. This could include video content, user interface designs for voice and screen, interaction models, prototypes, and interactive advertising campaigns. This role will use data and insights to create campaign strategy and concepts, develop designs and the look and feel for experiences, as well as templates for never-before-done brand campaigns and experiences that will solve customer problems, on and off Amazon platforms.

Candidates should have an in-depth understanding of AI tools, Photoshop, Illustrator, PowerPoint, Figma and Webflow, (or an interest to learn Webflow), and understanding of UX design.

The candidate’s portfolio should feature highly creative, award-winning campaigns and ideas that solve customer and advertiser problems through a variety of different media channels, including but not limited to video, social, digital activations, and outdoor. You have strong conceptual, presentation, storytelling, and time management skills, as well as digital media experience, insight-driven and strategic thinking, and of course, an acute attention to detail.

Key job responsibilities

Concept, design (art), and execute innovative ad campaigns and experiences for global brands.

Partner with designers, program managers, developers, strategists, business leads, and producers to create customer-focused solutions that deliver on advertiser objectives.

Independently lead campaigns from brief to execution and collaborate with internal teams, clients, and external agency partners.
Obsessed with understanding customers and making work that delivers both innovation and results.
Present ideas and concepts to clients, agencies, and internally.
Proven ability to ideate for film, print, digital, out-of-home, experiential, and social.
Ability to manage multiple projects at once within budget and deadlines.
Be proactive in developing new products and ideas on behalf of the customer.

A day in the life

Partnering with a variety of brands, media, and creative agencies to work on innovative campaigns for travel and tourism, automotive, finance, consumables, telecommunication etc.
From designing brand experiences (digital and physical), from documentary films in Prime Video to Alexa branded experiences, you will always strive to create never-before-done ideas.
Presenting a campaign to senior brand clients and their partners in creative and media agencies.
Reviewing edits and work in progress with your partners, collecting and responding to feedback in order to meet the highest creative standards.
Work with your team on proactive projects and initiatives and bring them to life.

About The Team

The Brand Innovation Lab is Amazon' Ads Innovation team dedicated to creating one-of-a-kind campaigns and activations for global advertisers.

Leveraging the full Amazon canvas: custom landing pages, Alexa, Fire TV, Twitch, Prime Video, and more. We build campaigns that reach millions of customers across digital channels and in the real world.

The team also works on Prime Video IP and brands, developing co-branded full-funnel campaigns.

Experience in driving compelling creative strategy and execution at an agency or in-house creative team
Experience communicating and delivering presentations to customers, stakeholders, and/or teammates
In-depth understanding of industry design tools (Ex. Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma), and a basic understanding of UX design and UX design Tools (ie. Webflow)

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, Keynote
Experience developing cross-functional relationships with product, consumer research and marketing teams to develop strategy and consumer insights that drive compelling creative executions
Experience leading creative development of innovative creative from concept to delivery
Experience presenting creative concepts effectively to senior executives
Experience managing multiple projects and meeting aggressive deadlines
Experience in developing creative concepts and executing campaigns for brand partnerships and/or sponsorships

new_jobs.description:
Ready to shape the future of travel marketing through creativity and innovation? Join TUI Musement as our Brand & AI Creative Designer, where you'll combine outstanding design craft with emerging AI technologies to create impactful brand campaigns, scalable creative systems and engaging customer experiences across global markets.

The role will be published until 5th of November.

About Our Offer

Personal benefits:
Attractive remuneration, discretionary bonus schemes, generous travel benefits, extensive health & well-being support, and more.

Flexible working:
Work is something you do, not somewhere you go. We encourage a healthy work-life balance with a dynamic working environment.

A career to shape:
Access the TUI Learning Hub to level-up and reach your ambitions.

Broaden your network:
We champion intercultural collaboration and provide opportunities to work on global projects and teams

Community:
Get involved with incredible local charity and sustainability initiatives like the TUI Care Foundation.

About The Job

You'll develop creative concepts and visual directions for integrated brand campaigns, translating audience insights, campaign objectives and brand strategy into compelling ideas and channel-ready creative solutions.
Creating and adapting assets across digital, social media, CRM, websites, retail environments, print and other customer touchpoints will be a key part of your role.
You'll help shape and evolve brand guidelines, creative frameworks and visual standards, making it easier for teams and markets to deliver consistent and effective brand experiences.
Using AI-assisted creative tools, you'll support ideation, visual exploration, prototyping and asset adaptation while applying strong creative judgement to ensure all outputs remain distinctive and brand-aligned.
You'll build scalable creative systems, templates and toolkits that enable efficient adaptation across markets, languages, formats and channels without compromising creative quality.
Working closely with content, campaign, video, production, commercial and product teams, you'll ensure creative ideas remain consistent and effective throughout delivery.
You'll present creative thinking with confidence, clearly articulating the rationale behind concepts, frameworks and design decisions to a variety of stakeholders.
By identifying opportunities to improve creative processes, brand application and AI-enabled workflows, you'll help make our creative output more consistent, scalable and future-ready.

About You

You have proven experience in brand design, graphic design, campaign creation, art direction or creative development within either an agency or in-house environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English allow you to communicate ideas clearly and effectively.
Your portfolio demonstrates strong concept development and execution across multiple channels, formats and customer touchpoints.
You've successfully contributed to brand guidelines, design systems, campaign toolkits or similar creative frameworks that support consistency and scalability.
Strong design craft enables you to create high-quality work across layout, typography, visual hierarchy, imagery and art direction for both digital and print channels.
You're confident using Adobe Creative Suite or equivalent professional design tools to bring ideas to life from concept through to final delivery.
Experience with AI-assisted creative tools, generative workflows or creative automation is highly desirable, alongside the ability to evaluate and refine outputs with a critical eye.
You can translate strategic objectives into compelling visual concepts and communicate your ideas through engaging storytelling and presentations.
Organised, proactive and collaborative, you're comfortable managing multiple briefs, stakeholder groups, feedback rounds and deadlines while maintaining creative excellence.
Experience working across multilingual, multi-market or matrix organisations would be advantageous.

From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless.
